name: Houshou Margo
source:
A con artist with a friendly demeanor, greeting everyone with a smile. A smooth talker with exceedingly sharp observation skills, and a keen eye for detail, quick on her feet. Despite being a mere 15-year old girl, she is a highly skilled con-artist, making a living through her fraudulent activities. She has no qualms about engaging in any and all manners of fraud, and is not above posing as an adult to employ seductive tactics as well. She has a mind set to 'never trust, never believe' and has no faith in the world—including, but not limited to people, objects, and even natural phenomena. She seems to not have a care in the world, always teasing others, dominating any conversation in which she partakes. Neither her smile nor her words are ever sincere.

Original Sin: A Person who Knows Love.
Magic: ???

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Margo_Housho]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Extended profiles are from the [url=https://https://manosaba.com/]Official Site[/url].]
